name: auto-checkpoint
description: Claude decides when to compact: past a token level it checkpoints to PROJECT_LOG.md at a safe sub-task boundary, compacts the same session and carries on

enabled.title: Auto-checkpoint
enabled.description: On: Claude checkpoints to PROJECT_LOG.md and the mod compacts; built-in Auto-compact is turned off. Off: the mod does nothing and built-in Auto-compact is turned back on. Takes effect at once; the next new session is fully switched.

taskCheckAt.title: New-task check (tokens)
taskCheckAt.description: From here, each prompt asks Claude to check whether a new task fits before starting it.

decideAt.title: Decision window (tokens)
decideAt.description: From here, Claude looks for a safe sub-task boundary to checkpoint.

mustAt.title: Must checkpoint (tokens)
mustAt.description: From here, Claude checkpoints at the very next sub-task boundary.

forceAt.title: Forced checkpoint (tokens)
forceAt.description: A turn that ends here with no checkpoint gets one from the mod. The four levels must rise in this order; otherwise all fall back to their defaults.

graphRefresh.title: Refresh graphify graph
graphRefresh.description: Before compacting, refresh the project's graphify graph where one exists.
